topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and frames how the concepts build upon prior material.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Sensing Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular mechanisms and receptors through which the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage.

topics.label: Inflammatory Signaling, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte trafficking into tissues and the resulting local and systemic consequences.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory responses are resolved, how tissues are repaired, and why chronic inflammatory states develop.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on complements.
